definitions.explanation: A hairstyle made by interweaving three strands of hair. Can also refer to braided cord or rope using the same three-strand technique.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}を{三|み}つ{編|あ}みにした。
{三|み}つ{編|あ}みの{女|おんな}の{子|こ}がいた。
examples.english: There was a girl with braids.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}に{三|み}つ{編|あ}みをしてもらうのが{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}の{楽|たの}しみだった。
examples.english: Having my mother braid my hair was one of my childhood pleasures.

notes:
The name literally means "three-strand weave." {三|み}つ{編|あ}み is the most common braid type referred to in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}みにする — to braid
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}みをほどく — to undo a braid
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}みのおさげ — braided pigtails

RELATED WORDS:
- {編|あ}む — to knit, to braid
- おさげ — pigtails
- ポニーテール — ponytail
